name: State-Space Pigeonhole Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "$2^3 = 8$ assignments to Line A and Line B" with a conceptual "no matter how each of the three nodes is assigned either a High or Low state". This removes the numeric triggers that LLMs use to recognize the 2-coloring/Bipartite impossibility condition on 3 vertices (which immediately implies a triangle). The models must now logically deduce that any boolean assignment to 3 nodes having an internal edge means all 3 pairs must be edges.
